answer.book: Anticosterus seu Enchiridii controversiarum praecipuarum nostri temporis (Franciscus Gomarus, Leiden 1599): one volume in two books, Liber primus (de discrimine haereticorum et catholicorum, 16 chapters) and Liber secundus (de sacra scriptura, 9 chapters), each chapter a Costerus-then-Gomarus refutation, with a dedication, a preface and the argument list of book 1 as front and back matter.
